decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY covering leaderboard/NFT-attribute accounting and the required one-ticket-to-one-$5-commission pairing; its prior random-reward rule already covers no-code assignments.
A same-message MODIFY already requires leaderboard totals to include one ticket and one $5 commission for every primary mint, including randomly assigned no-code rewards.
The existing FAQ state already describes no-code mints assigning the commission and prize ticket to a random existing NFT holder; this source does not require a new messaging change.
The configured no/invalid-code message already states that a $5 commission and $500 prize-draw ticket go to a random existing NFT holder.
The source clarifies reward assignment and accounting, not the existing $15 primary-mint revenue split or its $5 referral-commission allocation.
The client explicitly says coded-referral accounting is correct; the clarified change concerns rewards for mints without a referral code.
The source does not change which referral codes are valid or the self-referral prevention rules.
Reward assignment and accounting do not alter the badge set, icons, count, or grid presentation.
The source assumes completed mints and changes only their no-code reward assignment and accounting; it does not alter the NFT asset delivered by a mint.
The source does not change the NFT mint number used as the referral code, its persistence, or its display locations.
The clarification applies to post-mint no-code rewards and does not change the connected-wallet USDC approval-to-mint flow.
The source does not change optional tipping, its separate transaction timing, or its buyer disclosure.
